variants.name: exact COCO category name from instances_val2017.json
variants.synonym: one alternative wording per class, see synonym_kind
variants.description: short descriptive phrase that includes the class noun plus visual attributes
variants.template: CLIP-style template 'a photo of a {name}' (literal, no a/an correction)

synonym_kind.expansion: unabbreviated form of the COCO name (e.g. tv -> television)
synonym_kind.near: near-synonym, common subtype or regional term (not exactly equivalent)
synonym_kind.weak: no real English synonym exists; closest alternative wording (expected to hurt)
